jobs.description:
Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

As a warehouse worker for Nike ELC, you are trained to execute several tasks, such as loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing Nike products, orderpicking, labelling and packaging orders.
 

We are looking for all-round employees, who are flexible to rotate over several area’s and tasks.
 

Nike has excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience; enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important!
 

 

 
• Your knowledge of English is very good (you can find vacancies for Dutch speaking candidates on www.startpeople.be/nike)
 
• You want a full-time job and are eager to outperform during peak periods (working extended during weekends)
 
• You want to work in an early and late shift pattern (06h00-14h00 Mon-Fri, 14h00-22h00 the week after)
 
• You have your own means of transportation (the Nike campus is not accessible by bus or train)
 
• You are looking forward to having a dynamic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy orders (+/- 20 kg on a regular basis)

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for orderpicker for the Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Are you a true foodie who has always dreamed of a job in the food industry?
 

Do you have experience in production and are you ready to turn your passion for snacks into a career? Then we are looking for you!
 

 
 

What will you be doing?
 

 
• Producing the tastiest snacks in a modern food environment.
 
• Mixing ingredients and monitoring the production process.
 
• Ensuring quality and efficiency at every step.
 

 

 
•  
Experience in food production is an advantage (school leavers welcome!).
 
 
•  
Problem-solving skills and an eye for quality.
 
 
•  
Passion for good food.
 
 
•  
Willingness to work nights (9 p.m. to 5 a.m.).
 
 
•  
Fluency in English.

Are you passionate about connecting top talent with exciting career opportunities? This role combines end-to-end recruitment with operational HR support, offering variety, ownership, and direct business impact.

Client Details

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Description

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles
• Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from screening to offer stage
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements
• Support employer branding initiatives, onboarding activities, and HR projects

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Initial experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources
• Fluent communication skills in English and French, good level of Dutch
• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities
• Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented mindset

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: IT Recruitment Consultant - Sales & Recruitment - Brussels
jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:

Your responsibilities include:

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

We are looking for packing employees who can work in three shifts and would like to work in the food industry in Dendermonde.

You will work in the packing department of a company that specializes in packing frozen products. You will work in a refrigerated environment (around 10 degrees Celsius).

• Checking the quality of products

• Packing all kinds of products (e.g. fish, snacks, vegetables, ...) in boxes or bags

• Sticking labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Close communication with the operator

• ...

• You have previous experience in a production environment and can work flexible in three shifts.

• You do not mind performing physical work at pace.

• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language in case of safety instructions.

• As the company is located in an industrial zone, it is not accessible by public transport. You can travel each day independently to Dendermonde.

• You are looking for long-term employment and do not mind performing a 2h packing test after a positive job interview.

jobs.occupation: Talencia Consulting - ERP Project Manager Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a "Domain Lead Supply Chain" for one of its clients.

 

Location : Bruxelles and La Louviére

Start date : October

Duration : 2 years

 

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead and coordinate a major ERP transformation project focused on Supply Chain processes.

The Project Manager will be responsible for coordinating the different functional and technical teams involved in the project, with a particular focus on the analysis and design phase.

You will act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, functional analysts, technical teams, key users and external implementation partners. Your role is to ensure that the different teams work towards a common objective, that dependencies are properly managed and that the analysis activities progress according to scope, planning and quality expectations.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing complex ERP projects and is comfortable operating in environments involving multiple stakeholders, parallel workstreams and significant business transformation.

Description

Project management & coordination:

 
• Take ownership of the overall planning and coordination of the ERP project.
 
• Coordinate multiple functional and technical workstreams.
 
• Define and monitor project milestones, deliverables, dependencies and priorities.
 
• Ensure that the different teams remain aligned with the overall project objectives.
 
• Organise and facilitate project meetings, workshops and follow-up sessions.
 
• Monitor progress and proactively identify delays, dependencies, risks and blockers.
 
• Ensure effective communication between business, IT and implementation partners.
 
• Provide regular project status reporting to management and key stakeholders.

 

Coordination of the analysis phase:

 

A major part of the role will be to coordinate and structure the functional analysis activities rather than performing all analysis personally.

 
• Coordinate the functional analysts working on the different Supply Chain processes.
 
• Structure the analysis approach, priorities and deliverables.
 
• Ensure that functional teams have a clear understanding of scope and expected outcomes.
 
• Coordinate workshops with business stakeholders and key users.
 
• Ensure consistency between analyses performed across different processes and teams.
 
• Identify gaps, overlaps and dependencies between functional workstreams.
 
• Challenge proposed solutions where necessary and ensure alignment with the overall ERP strategy.
 
• Track open points, decisions, assumptions and actions resulting from the analysis.
 
• Ensure that functional specifications and process documentation are delivered on time and with the expected quality.

 

Supply chain ERP transformation:

 

The project focuses on the transformation and optimisation of Supply Chain processes within an ERP environment, including areas such as

 
• Procurement and purchasing
 
• Supplier processes
 
• Product and article master data
 
• Inventory and stock management
 
• Warehouse management
 
• Order management
 
• Logistics and delivery processes
 
• End-to-end Supply Chain process flows
 
• Integration with other ERP and business processes

The project manager

does not need to be the deepest functional expert in every area, but must have sufficient ERP and Supply Chain understanding to coordinate experts, challenge decisions and understand project impacts and...

Must have:

• 7+ years of experience in IT Project Management, ideally within ERP transformation projects

• Proven experience coordinating multiple teams and workstreams

• Experience managing projects involving business analysis and functional design

• Strong understanding of ERP environments and Supply Chain processes

• Experience coordinating functional analysts and business stakeholders

• Strong project planning, dependency and risk management skills

• Experience working with external implementation partners

• Strong stakeholder management and communication capabilities

• Ability to challenge functional solutions without necessarily being the hands-on expert

• Experience working in complex transformation environments

• Fluent in French and English

 

Nice to have:

• Experience with large-scale ERP implementations or rollouts

• Previous experience in Supply Chain transformation projects

• Experience with data migration or master data projects

• Experience in Agile, hybrid or Waterfall project environments

• Experience coordinating international teams

 

In case of interest in this job, please send us immediately your updated resume.

Kind Regards,

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.	
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.	
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.	
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:
	
• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.	
• CRR holder credentials.	
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.	
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.
